title: Taurine mitigates bisphenol A-induced maternal–fetal oxidative stress and improves fetal weight by regulating Nrf2-Keap1 pathway, gut microbiota and bile acid metabolism

sections.abstract: <jats:p>Taurine mitigates bisphenol A (BPA) exposure-induced disruption of the maternal–fetal environment, resulting in fetal growth restriction and tissue damage.</jats:p>
